title: Filtering the employees table by text

steps.title: Keep rows where name is Imane Naciri
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like 'Imane Naciri'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name = 'Imane Naciri';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name = 'Imane Naciri';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name = 'Imane Naciri';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for names starting 'Ima'
steps.prompt:
LIKE searches by pattern using the % wildcard.
Ima% means 'starts with'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name LIKE 'Ima%';
hints: Write: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name LIKE 'Ima%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name LIKE 'Ima%';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for 'man' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %man% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name LIKE '%man%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name LIKE '%man%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE name LIKE '%man%';
